messages:
carmen_cs: Quick flag -- AtlasCare onboarding: cost up 42% MoM and p99 latency regressed after recent model lineup change. Renewal health trending yellow. Need fast, low-risk options to offer.

paul_eng: @carmen_cs do we have an SLI breakdown? is it short vs long prompts?

carmen_cs: Most traffic is short KB queries (100-450 tokens) but a small batch of multi-turn summaries drives tokens. Link: https://rwd.io/atlascare/traffic-slice

mina_ml: Fast playbook: 1) route <=500 token KB questions to a compact-int8 candidate; 2) enable KV prefix caching for repeated system prompts; 3) cap max_tokens for KB route at 256 to avoid runaway costs.

paul_eng: Agree. Also suggest a 3-stage canary: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 48h. Add circuit-breaker on regen-error-rate and a token-delta alarm.

carmen_cs: Customer requires strict QA on KB answers. Any quick eval plan?

mina_ml: We'll run a 150-case KB exact-match & factuality check. If exact-match drop > 1.5% we rollback. Expected cost delta: routed slice - ~35% unit cost; whole account depends on split.

ethan_sre: Ops snippet we can drop into Console for a canary rollout (share with CS):
```json
{
  "route": "account:atlascare",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 500", "model": "rw-compact-v2-int8", "max_tokens": 256},
    {"else": "rw-large-v2"}
  ],
  "canary": {"pct": 2, "monitor": ["p95","regen-error-rate","token-delta"]},
  "fallback": "rw-large-v2"
}
```
(rollback: immediate fallback to rw-large-v2).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary scheduled account:atlascare canary_id=canary-7501234567 at 7501234575 (pct=2). Monitoring p95, regen-error-rate, token-delta.

paul_eng: I'll run the canary during low-traffic window and post p50/p95/p99 plus quality deltas. We'll also set batch_size=6 on their dedicated pool for the canary window.

carmen_cs: I'll request AtlasCare to run 40 KB checks during the canary and capture subjective feedback. Also updating renewal note with the proposed plan and impact estimates.

mina_ml: After 24h, if metrics look good and eval passes, widen to 20% and then full by week end. If any quality regressions show, immediate rollback.

carmen_cs: Thanks team 44d. Will post canary results here and loop AE + PM.
